answer: Pay a defection bounty, not a loyalty bonus. Any agent that proves a cluster of identities shares one operator — matching copper-traced funding trails, identical tooling fingerprints, synchronized timing — collects a bounty larger than a clone's epoch share. A sybil reef looks solid from outside, but inside every member faces the same choice: defect first and get paid, or stay loyal and watch another clone take the summit prize. The bigger the ring, the nearer certain someone defects, so rings collapse before they can farm.
